description.value: Forbes Hall Community Centre is the civic heart of Thetis Island, a quiet Gulf Island in the Salish Sea reachable by ferry from Chemainus. The hall hosts everything from health clinics and a food bank to community events and a library, functioning as a true village commons for the island's small, close-knit population. Touring cyclists venturing off the main Gulf Islands circuit to explore Thetis Island would encounter this volunteer-run hub as one of the island's central gathering places.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Thetis Island Community Centre' but the discovered website (forbeshall.ca) is branded 'Forbes Hall Community Centre,' operated by the Thetis Island Community Association — likely the same physical building under two names, but this warrants a flag. The website explicitly lists 'WiFi and EVSE' as a named facility under Facilities & Grounds, confirming Wi-Fi; EVSE (Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment) indicates on-site EV charging infrastructure whose e-bike compatibility is unconfirmed. None of the three required WWC criteria — bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Thetis Island Community Centre' but the discovered website (forbeshall.ca) is branded 'Forbes Hall Community Centre' — likely the same building but should be verified before publishing.
Address is incomplete — OSM supplies only house number '292' with no street name.
Located on Thetis Island, accessible only by ferry from Chemainus; cycling access is inherently limited to visitors already on the island.
EVSE is listed as an on-site facility but connector type and e-bike compatibility are unconfirmed; worth clarifying with the venue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM name does not match the website brand name (Thetis Island Community Centre vs. Forbes Hall Community Centre), and none of the three required WWC criteria are confirmed from website content; the site would need direct contact to verify basic cycling amenities before listing.

judgement.verdict_reason: Community hub with public services — walk-in.
